rationale: The attic motion sensor (SEN-M1) was offline with battery at 8%, below the 10% threshold where these sensors miss events. Signal was strong (-62 dBm), firmware was current and protocol-compatible, and there were no fault codes or protocol conflicts. Replacing the battery restored the sensor online and it triggered a motion notification, confirming the battery was the cause rather than heat damage or a hardware fault.

repair_steps: Replace the attic motion sensor's battery with a fresh one of the correct type.
Confirm the sensor comes back online in the app.
Test the sensor by triggering a motion event and verifying a notification is received.
output.customer_reply: The attic motion sensor is working again after a battery replacement. The low battery was causing it to miss events, even before the warning appeared. The sensor itself is fine—no heat damage. No need to replace it. If you have any further issues, let us know.

results.text: CAM-S1 runs on a rechargeable battery lasting 3 to 6 months. Below 10 percent the camera disables live view and may miss events; below 3 percent it goes offline. Charge with the supplied USB-C cable for about 6 hours. Frequent motion events in busy areas shorten battery life; enable power-saving mode.
